stories.question: Which antibiotic resistance genes do these Klebsiella isolates carry?

why.route: The question asks for an analysis of the user's own samples (genome assemblies registered in NExtSEEK); the router sends that to nextseek_query, whose pipeline agent offers the nf-core run.
why.pipelines: Three Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates, each with its own bacass assembly registered as an A.ASM FASTA: assemblies, which funcscan screens. Resistance genes are the ARG screen, so run_arg_screening is on. taxprofiler profiles raw reads for organisms and does not read assemblies.

ruling.note: Drafted with the eight new nf-core pipelines (2026-11-19); awaits the owner's ruling, the cohort's upload and a paid run.

stories.question: How do these eight E. coli strains differ from one another across their whole genomes?

why.route: The question asks for an analysis of the user's own samples (genome assemblies registered in NExtSEEK); the router sends that to nextseek_query, whose pipeline agent offers the nf-core run.
why.pipelines: One A.ASM sample whose file is eight E. coli strain genomes in one bgzipped, PanSN-named FASTA (GenomeCount 8): pangenome's input, with n_haplotypes 8 read from GenomeCount. Whole-genome differences among strains of one species, shared and variable sequence and structural variation, is a variation graph. sarek reads short reads against one human reference and cannot read assemblies.

ruling.note: Drafted with the eight new nf-core pipelines (2026-11-19); awaits the owner's ruling, the cohort's upload and a paid run.
